scheduling_strategy: Solve the five mutual omitted matchups as a minimum-cost perfect matching. Completed/partial series are immutable. Future scheduled series are preserved unless a valid 8-opponent schedule requires a future-only swap.

simulation.variance: game-level hitter noise plus probabilistic PA outcomes
simulation.stats: full batting and pitching lines retained for every simulated series
simulation.regular_season: all solver-approved series included until 24-game / 8-opponent structure is complete
